{{nihongo|'''Kamo Yamaguchi Shrine'''|鴨山口神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

=== History ===
=== Overview ===
The date of foundation is unknown. In the {{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}, within the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Register of Deities}}, it is listed as “{{ill|Yamato Province|Q907495|qid=Q907495}}{{ill|Katsujō district|Q11620858|qid=Q11620858}} Kamoyamaguchi Shrine, Major, Monthly and Harvest Offerings,” and it is also counted as one of the eighty-five deities of the rain-prayer rituals. Although there are fourteen Yamaguchi shrines, the Kamoyamaguchi Shrine of Katsujo District is considered the head shrine. It was also called the Upper Kamo Shrine in contrast to the Lower Kamo Shrine ({{ill|Kamo Tsuba Shrine|ja|鴨都波神社|qid=Q11675614}}).

Under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=Modern shrine ranking system}}, it was ranked as a village shrine.

=== Divine rank ===
* In the 3rd year of {{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611|lt=Ten’an}} ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}), on {{ill|January 27|Q2284|qid=Q2284}}, it was promoted from Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade to Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade ({{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|cs|Nihon Sandai Džicuroku|de|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|es|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fa|نیهون ساندای جیتسوروکو|ff|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fr|Nihon sandai jitsuroku|it|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ja|日本三代実録|ko|일본삼대실록|pt|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ru|Нихон сандай дзицуроку|simple|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|zh|日本三代實錄|zh_classical|日本三代實錄|qid=Q1052981}}). The notation used is “Kamoyamaguchi-no-Kami.”
